news.title: Zyphor OS beta ISO is ready to test
news.author: Zyphor Team
news.summary: The first public beta ISO is available for testers on real hardware and virtual machines.
content: The beta ISO boots to a live desktop and includes the installer, first-boot setup and the default tools.
We are asking testers to try it in a virtual machine first, then on spare hardware, and report anything that looks wrong.
Bug reports with the output of the system info command are the most useful kind.

news.title: How Linux boots, from firmware to login
news.author: Zyphor Team
news.summary: A walk through each stage of startup, with what runs, what it hands off to, and where to look when it fails.
content: Firmware starts the bootloader. The bootloader loads the kernel and an initial RAM disk into memory.
The kernel mounts the real root filesystem and starts the init system, which brings up services in order.
When a boot fails, the stage that last printed output tells you where to start looking.

news.title: Packages explained: what apt actually does
news.author: Zyphor Team
news.summary: Install, remove and update software with confidence by learning what happens behind each command.
content: A package bundles files, metadata and the list of other packages it needs.
When you install one, the package manager resolves those needs, downloads everything and unpacks it into place.
Reading the dry-run output before you confirm shows exactly what will change.

news.title: Open community call: roadmap and contributors
news.author: Zyphor Team
news.summary: Join the open call to hear what is planned next and how to help with code, design and testing.
content: The call covers the near-term roadmap, open issues that need owners and how reviews work.
Newcomers are welcome. You do not need to write code to help: testing, writing and artwork all count.
Notes from the call will be posted here afterwards.
